title: Theme #50 Coverage x Evidence Matrix (proposal)
note: Proposal tool, not consensus output. Rows are ordered by WITNESS (who other than the author can confirm), not by mechanism. Assurance basis and operational effect are claim-specific, potentially multi-valued dimensions (per 2026-10-29 discussion consensus). Hotspots revised per S6 external review (Muse, 2026-10-30): two hotspots instead of one.

hotspots.meaning: no evidence of any kind exists; the topic itself is missing

hotspots.where: covered-but-unwitnessed diagonal (fully x self-declared, partly x specification)
hotspots.meaning: format completeness is not technical completeness: looks complete, never run, never witnessed

danger_cell.claim: claimed-but-absent: a coverage claim about an uncovered topic is false coverage - more dangerous than silence

additional_multivalued_dimensions: assurance basis (self-declared / independently verified / credential-backed / runtime-attested - not a rank)
operational effect (describes / enforces / evaluates - not a rank)
external_review: Muse S6 (2026-10-30): PASS-with-changes; three changes applied (two hotspots, two renamed cells, capability language in mapping)
